status: native v1 implemented and cross-compiled; host tests passed; device validation pending

display.text: native readable Cyrillic; wrap prose; align addresses and numbers; scroll long content

entry.launch: MK61AI.APP from Explorer; a calculator-menu shortcut may pass a copied program
entry.new_task: free Russian/English text; tests and starting program are optional
entry.explain_mode: inspect the selected program and execute isolated examples or traces; publish replacement code only after switching to correction mode

views.label: Диалог
views.submit_while_running: request pause, then append the new instruction and restart from a consistent task revision
views.long_input: retain full text on SD; if mandatory details do not fit model context, request a shorter task or selected excerpt; never silently discard

views.label: Код
content: test status for exactly this version
views.manual_edit: pause first; create a new immutable version; mark its test results stale
views.code_visibility: publish only complete validated write_program output; incomplete generated text stays in generation state

views.label: Тесты
content: actual output for a specific program version
pass, mismatch, execution error or limit
views.model_proposed_case: draft until user supplies or confirms expected output; confirmation is recorded, not mathematical proof
views.observe_only: show actual result and stop reason; never count as passed
views.interactive_programs: allow staged inputs and pauses as a future case type; manually inspect games in the calculator first

views.label: Ход
views.reasoning: short plan and observable actions; do not fabricate a detailed thought transcript

keyboard.F1-F4: switch views without changing input focus semantics
keyboard.F5: start or resume solving; while running, pause; when an answer is required, focus input instead of bypassing the question
keyboard.Tab: open contextual actions; never insert a tab into ordinary task text
keyboard.Enter: send the composer text, select a menu item or open the selected object
keyboard.Up/Down: scroll or select a list row
keyboard.Left/Right: move text cursor or change a field; never switch tabs while editing
keyboard.Esc: cancel local edit or close a menu first; otherwise request pause while running; from an idle root view return to sessions
keyboard.no_implicit_send: changing tabs or leaving an editor preserves the draft

result.apply: explicit user action; snapshot the current calculator; load the selected program version
result.registers: keep live registers by default; loading an example's input values is a separate explicit action

persistence.checkpoint: after each complete tool result or user edit; atomic commit or recoverable journal
persistence.resume: open the last committed state; rebuild model context and KV as needed; do not promise cached inference survives power loss
persistence.eviction: discard old KV/cache rather than task content; archived traces may stay on SD
persistence.exit: pause and checkpoint before releasing inference resources

controller_rules: One foreground job; every generated action carries a task/program revision.
Ignore stale tool replies after user edits or changes the active version.
Run generated programs in an isolated calculator snapshot with command/time limits.
Limit attempts, generation and tool execution independently; offer a concrete continuation after stopping.
Only fully parsed, allowed tool actions execute; malformed calls produce bounded feedback.
Tool protocol is versioned with the trained model; UI tabs do not change model protocol.
Manual code edits and test edits invalidate affected verification results; changing the language model restarts generation but preserves independent results for unchanged calculator code and tests.
A model done tag ends an attempt; verification state comes from actual executions.

prototype.scenario: arithmetic mean of R0 and R1, result in X
prototype.emulator_examples: both displayed program versions were checked against the production host core

implementation.stm32_and_spectrum: Applications run in turn. No simultaneous audio load is assumed. UART/STM32 firmware changes are owned by the Spectrum work.
